keyVerseDR: "...falling down they adored him: and opening their treasures, they offered him gifts..." (Mt 2:11)

level1.title: Wise Men Follow the Star
level1.story: Wise men followed a bright star to find Jesus. They bowed down and gave Him gifts. We give Jesus our hearts!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: What gifts did the Wise Men bring?
What gift can you give Jesus?
level1.prayer: Jesus, I give You my heart. Amen.

activity.title: A gift for Jesus
activity.intro: The wise men gave gold, incense, and myrrh. Draw your gift for Jesus.
activity.prompt: A gift box for Jesus, with what I will give Him (a prayer, a kind act, my heart)

level2.title: The Magi Find the King
level2.story: Wise men from the East came to Jerusalem asking, "Where is the newborn king of the Jews? We saw His star." King Herod was troubled and sent them to Bethlehem. The star went ahead of them and stopped over the place where the child was. They bowed down and worshiped Jesus, and gave Him gold, frankincense, and myrrh. Warned in a dream, they went home another way.
level2.keyLine: Falling down they adored him: and they offered him gifts.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What does each gift say about Jesus?
How do you 'follow the star' today?
level2.prayer: Jesus, King of all, I offer You my life. Amen.

activity.title: Secret message of the Magi
activity.intro: Use the code to find out what the wise men did.
